description: Ministry of Higher Education - Order to amend the Gaz. Ex. No. 1395/15, entering Department of Applied Earth Sciences to the Uva Wellassa University
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves a legal/regulatory matter - specifically an amendment to the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978. It contains an official order made under statutory powers (Section 27(1) read with Section 21) to amend the schedule establishing the Uva Wellassa University of Sri Lanka by adding a new department. While it mentions a minister's name, this is in the context of exercising legal authority to make a regulatory change rather than focusing on personnel appointment or detailed portfolio responsibilities. The core content is about modifying the legal framework governing universities.
